title: Man in Cardigan & Newsboy Cap, 1920s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor snapshot of a young man posing in a yard. He is dressed in classic 1920s casual fashion, featuring a flat newsboy cap, a dark button-down cardigan sweater over a collared shirt and tie, and high-waisted trousers. Behind him is a wooden fence structure and a clapboard building.
